title: MISAALE BADR JOH HAASIL HUVA KAMAAL MUJHE
body:
MISAALE BADR JOH HAASIL HUVA KAMAAL MUJHE
GHATA GHATA KE FALAK NE KIYA HILAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
TERI MADAD KA FAQATH YA ALI BHAROSA HAI
KISI KI AAS NAHIN WAQTE INTEQAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
KAREEM JOH TUJHE DENA HO BETALAB DEDEY
FAQEER HOON PA NAHIN HAAJATE SAWAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
KISI KE SAAMNE KYON JAAKE HAATH PHAILAAOON
MERA KAREEM JO DEYTAH HAI BAY SAWAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KEHTEY THAY PUSHTAY FARAS SE GIRTAH HOON
MADAD KA WAQT HAI AE BEKASI SAMBHAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN KEHTEY THAY PARWARDIGAAR RAHIYO GAWAAH
KE QATL KARTEY HAIN NAAHAQ YEH BADH QISAAL MUJHE
<<DIVIDER>>
ANDHERI QABR MEIN MUSHKIL ANEES KO HAI BOHATH
DIKHAADOH YA ALI AB CHAAND SA JAMAAL MUHJHE
